## Two packages, one statistical workflow {#opening}

<div class="br-pipeline">
<div class="br-stage">
<h3>High-dimensional data</h3>
<p>Many correlated variables, few samples, multiple assays, or a response to predict.</p>
</div>
<div class="br-arrow">→</div>
<div class="br-stage green">
<h3>BigRiverEssence</h3>
<p>Extract low-dimensional, sparse, supervised, or shared structure.</p>
</div>
<div class="br-arrow">→</div>
<div class="br-stage">
<h3>BigRiverPlots</h3>
<p>Turn scores, loadings, variance, and predictions into interpretable graphics.</p>
</div>
</div>

<br>

<div class="uthsc-green-box br-center">
The interface between the packages is not a special object—it is the statistical output itself.
</div>

::: {.notes}
- Introduce the packages as separable but complementary.
- BigRiverPlots accepts ordinary arrays, so it is useful beyond BigRiverEssence.
- Timing: 1.5 minutes.
- [Sources] https://github.com/senresearch/BigRiverEssence.jl ; https://github.com/senresearch/BigRiverPlots.jl
:::

## The obstacle is not just size {#problem}

<div class="br-kicker">A familiar omics geometry</div>

::: columns
::: column

- thousands of variables
- correlated measurements
- fewer samples than features
- multiple data types on the same people
- signal mixed with noise

<div class="uthsc-orange-box" style="margin-top:18px;">
The question changes the decomposition: variance, prediction, sparsity, correlation, or integration.
</div>

:::
::: column

```{ojs}
d3 = require("d3@7")

brColors = ({orange:"#E78824", dark:"#C14C23", green:"#4D701F", teal:"#007E5A", ink:"#2a2a2a", pale:"#f5f1eb"})

brRng = function(seed) {
  let s = seed >>> 0;
  return () => {
    s = (s + 0x6d2b79f5) >>> 0;
    let t = s;
    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), 1 | t);
    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t);
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

omicsMatrix = {
  const rng = brRng(17), rows=18, cols=54, W=560, H=320;
  const pad={l:58,r:10,t:36,b:24};
  const cw=(W-pad.l-pad.r)/cols, ch=(H-pad.t-pad.b)/rows;
  const svg=d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox",`0 0 ${W} ${H}`).style("width","100%");
  const color=d3.scaleSequential(d3.interpolateRgbBasis(["#007E5A","#f4f1ec","#E78824"])).domain([-1.7,1.7]);
  for(let i=0;i<rows;i++) for(let j=0;j<cols;j++) {
    const block=(i<6?1:i<12?-1:.3)*(j>18&&j<35?1:0);
    const wave=.55*Math.sin(j/5+i/3);
    const noise=(rng()-.5)*1.25;
    svg.append("rect").attr("x",pad.l+j*cw).attr("y",pad.t+i*ch)
      .attr("width",cw-.7).attr("height",ch-.7).attr("rx",.8).attr("fill",color(block+wave+noise));
  }
  svg.append("text").attr("x",pad.l).attr("y",22).attr("font-size",14).attr("font-weight",700).attr("fill",brColors.ink).text("variables → thousands");
  svg.append("text").attr("transform",`translate(17,${H/2}) rotate(-90)`).attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",14).attr("font-weight",700).attr("fill",brColors.ink).text("samples");
  return svg.node();
}
```

:::
:::

::: {.notes}
- Emphasize that the package collection is organized by statistical question, not by one universal algorithm.
- The heatmap is synthetic and generated in the browser.
- Timing: 1.5 minutes.
- [Sources] Package description: https://github.com/senresearch/BigRiverEssence.jl
:::

## One package, five kinds of questions {#questions}

<p class="br-small">Choose a question to see the corresponding methods.</p>

```{ojs}
questionFrames = [
  {label:"Compress", q:"What are the dominant directions?", methods:"PCA", detail:"Dense, ordered components that summarize variance."},
  {label:"Predict", q:"Which directions track an outcome?", methods:"PLSkern · PLS-DA", detail:"Latent components built around a continuous response or class label."},
  {label:"Select", q:"Which variables actually carry the signal?", methods:"PMD · SPC · sPLS-DA", detail:"L1-constrained loadings turn a dense direction into a short feature list."},
  {label:"Relate", q:"What structure is shared by two blocks?", methods:"CCA · SCCA", detail:"Pairs of directions maximize cross-block association, densely or sparsely."},
  {label:"Integrate", q:"What is shared—and what is assay-specific?", methods:"JIVE", detail:"Separate joint, individual, and residual variation across multiple blocks."}
]

viewof questionPick = {
  const wrap=html`<div></div>`, bar=html`<div class="br-selector"></div>`;
  const buttons=questionFrames.map((d,i)=>{ const b=html`<button>${d.label}</button>`; b.onclick=()=>{wrap.value=i; draw(); wrap.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true}));}; bar.append(b); return b; });
  const draw=()=>buttons.forEach((b,i)=>b.classList.toggle("on",i===wrap.value));
  wrap.value=0; draw(); wrap.append(bar); return wrap;
}
```

```{ojs}
questionCard = {
  const d=questionFrames[questionPick];
  const card=html`<div style="border-top:5px solid ${brColors.orange};background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:20px 26px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.10);min-height:210px"></div>`;
  card.append(html`<div style="font:800 29px inherit;color:${brColors.dark};margin-bottom:12px">${d.q}</div>`);
  card.append(html`<div style="font:800 21px inherit;color:${brColors.green};margin-bottom:12px">${d.methods}</div>`);
  card.append(html`<div style="font:400 18px/1.45 inherit;color:${brColors.ink}">${d.detail}</div>`);
  return card;
}
```

::: {.notes}
- Click through all five questions.
- The package currently exposes PCA, PMD, SPC, PLSkern, JIVE, PLSDA, SPLSDA, CCA, and SCCA.
- Timing: 2 minutes.
- [Sources] Exported API and method list: https://github.com/senresearch/BigRiverEssence.jl
:::

## Compression is a controllable trade-off {#compression}

<p class="br-small">Add components automatically or drag the slider. More structure is recovered, but the representation grows.</p>

```{ojs}
compressionData = {
  const rng=brRng(41), n=22, p=46, R=7;
  const U=[],V=[],s=[8.5,6.0,4.2,3.0,2.0,1.3,.8];
  for(let r=0;r<R;r++){
    let u=d3.range(n).map(i=>Math.sin((r+1)*Math.PI*i/n+r*.7));
    let v=d3.range(p).map(j=>Math.cos((r+1)*Math.PI*j/(p/2)+r*.45));
    const nu=Math.hypot(...u),nv=Math.hypot(...v); U.push(u.map(x=>x/nu));V.push(v.map(x=>x/nv));
  }
  const M=d3.range(n).map(i=>d3.range(p).map(j=>d3.sum(d3.range(R),r=>s[r]*U[r][i]*V[r][j])+.025*(rng()-.5)));
  return {n,p,R,U,V,s,M,max:d3.max(M.flat(),x=>Math.abs(x))};
}

viewof ncomp = {
  const max=compressionData.R, wrap=html`<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-size:17px;flex-wrap:wrap"></div>`;
  const range=html`<input type="range" min="1" max="${max}" value="1" step="1" style="width:260px;accent-color:#E78824">`;
  const val=html`<span style="font-weight:900;color:#C14C23;min-width:20px">1</span>`;
  const play=html`<button style="padding:6px 14px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#007E5A;color:#fff;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer">▶ build</button>`;
  let timer;
  const set=v=>{range.value=v;val.textContent=v;wrap.value=+v;wrap.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true}));};
  range.oninput=()=>set(range.value);
  play.onclick=()=>{clearInterval(timer);let k=1;set(k);timer=setInterval(()=>{k++;if(k>max){clearInterval(timer);return;}set(k);},500);};
  wrap.value=1;wrap.append(html`<b>Components kept:</b>`,range,val,play);return wrap;
}
```

```{ojs}
compressionFig = {
  const D=compressionData,k=ncomp,W=1040,H=310,cw=6.2,y0=48;
  const rec=d3.range(D.n).map(i=>d3.range(D.p).map(j=>d3.sum(d3.range(k),r=>D.s[r]*D.U[r][i]*D.V[r][j])));
  const color=d3.scaleSequential(d3.interpolateRgbBasis([brColors.teal,"#f4f1ec",brColors.orange])).domain([-D.max,D.max]);
  const svg=d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox",`0 0 ${W} ${H}`).style("width","100%").style("font-family","inherit");
  const block=(A,x,label)=>{svg.append("text").attr("x",x).attr("y",28).attr("font-size",15).attr("font-weight",800).attr("fill",brColors.ink).text(label);for(let i=0;i<D.n;i++)for(let j=0;j<D.p;j++)svg.append("rect").attr("x",x+j*cw).attr("y",y0+i*cw).attr("width",cw-.5).attr("height",cw-.5).attr("fill",color(A[i][j]));};
  block(D.M,20,"Original matrix"); block(rec,420,`Rank-${k} reconstruction`);
  svg.append("text").attr("x",355).attr("y",y0+D.n*cw/2).attr("font-size",32).attr("font-weight",900).attr("fill",brColors.dark).text("≈");
  const captured=d3.sum(D.s.slice(0,k),x=>x*x)/d3.sum(D.s,x=>x*x);
  const bx=420,by=230,bw=480;
  svg.append("rect").attr("x",bx).attr("y",by).attr("width",bw).attr("height",24).attr("rx",6).attr("fill","#e7e7e7");
  svg.append("rect").attr("x",bx).attr("y",by).attr("width",bw*captured).attr("height",24).attr("rx",6).attr("fill",brColors.orange);
  svg.append("text").attr("x",bx).attr("y",by-8).attr("font-size",14).attr("font-weight",800).attr("fill",brColors.ink).text("Signal variation recovered");
  svg.append("text").attr("x",bx+bw+12).attr("y",by+19).attr("font-size",17).attr("font-weight",900).attr("fill",brColors.dark).text(`${(100*captured).toFixed(0)}%`);
  svg.append("text").attr("x",bx).attr("y",by+52).attr("font-size",13).attr("fill","#666").text(`Store ${k} × (${D.n} + ${D.p}) values instead of ${D.n} × ${D.p}`);
  return svg.node();
}
```

::: {.notes}
- Connect the animation to PCA and low-rank matrix decomposition.
- The synthetic matrix has seven ordered latent components.
- Timing: 2 minutes.
- [Sources] PCA API and reconstruction functions: https://senresearch.github.io/BigRiverEssence.jl/dev/pca_tutorial/
:::

## The PCA API keeps the workflow explicit {#pca-api}

::: columns
::: column

<div class="br-code">

```julia
using BigRiverEssence

m = pca(X;
    k = 4,
    standardize = true
)

scores = pca_transform(m, X)
X̂ = pca_invtransform(m, scores)

m.loadings
m.propOFvar
```

</div>

:::
::: column

<div class="br-method-grid" style="grid-template-columns:1fr;">
<div class="br-method"><strong>Fit</strong><br>Estimate ordered directions from the training matrix.</div>
<div class="br-method"><strong>Transform</strong><br>Represent observations in component space.</div>
<div class="br-method"><strong>Invert</strong><br>Map scores back to an approximation of the original variables.</div>
</div>

<div class="br-notice" style="margin-top:16px;">
The model stores what downstream graphics need: scores, loadings, and proportion of variance.
</div>

:::
:::

::: {.notes}
- The point is the small, predictable API surface.
- Mention that observations are rows and variables are columns for the single-matrix methods.
- Timing: 1.5 minutes.
- [Sources] https://senresearch.github.io/BigRiverEssence.jl/dev/pca_tutorial/
:::

## Supervision rotates the question {#supervision}

<p class="br-small">PCA and PLS emphasize different directions. The moving line is horizontal for PCA and vertical for PLS.</p>

```{ojs}
supervisedData = {
  const rng=brRng(123), pts=[];
  const randn=()=>{let u=0,v=0;while(!u)u=rng();while(!v)v=rng();return Math.sqrt(-2*Math.log(u))*Math.cos(2*Math.PI*v);};
  for(let g=0;g<2;g++)for(let i=0;i<90;i++)pts.push({x:(g?1.4:-1.4)+.55*randn(),y:.35*randn(),g});
  return pts;
}

viewof directionMode = {
  const wrap=html`<div class="br-selector"></div>`;
  const labels=["PCA: most variance","PLS: tracks outcome"];
  const bs=labels.map((x,i)=>{const b=html`<button>${x}</button>`;b.onclick=()=>set(i);wrap.append(b);return b;});
  const render=()=>bs.forEach((b,i)=>b.classList.toggle("on",i===wrap.value));
  const set=v=>{wrap.value=v;render();wrap.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true}));};
  wrap.value=0;render();return wrap;
}
```

```{ojs}
supervisedFig = {
  const data=supervisedData,mode=directionMode,W=1000,H=350,pad=42,duration=850;
  const oldMode=globalThis.__brDirectionMode ?? mode,oldSep=globalThis.__brDirectionSep ?? 0;
  const angle=mode===0?Math.PI/2:0,oldAngle=oldMode===0?Math.PI/2:0;
  const dir={x:Math.cos(angle),y:Math.sin(angle)},oldDir={x:Math.cos(oldAngle),y:Math.sin(oldAngle)};
  const svg=d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox",`0 0 ${W} ${H}`).style("width","100%").style("font-family","inherit");
  const x=d3.scaleLinear().domain([-4.4,4.4]).range([pad,620]),y=d3.scaleLinear().domain([-2.85,2.85]).range([H-pad,pad]);
  const colors=[brColors.orange,brColors.teal],mx=d3.mean(data,d=>d.x),my=d3.mean(data,d=>d.y);
  const score=(d,v)=>(d.x-mx)*v.x+(d.y-my)*v.y;
  const projected=data.map((d,i)=>{const t=score(d,dir),ot=score(d,oldDir);return {...d,i,t,ot,px:mx+t*dir.x,py:my+t*dir.y,opx:mx+ot*oldDir.x,opy:my+ot*oldDir.y};});
  const byGroup=[projected.filter(d=>d.g===0),projected.filter(d=>d.g===1)];
  const separation=key=>{const a=byGroup[0].map(d=>d[key]),b=byGroup[1].map(d=>d[key]);return Math.abs(d3.mean(a)-d3.mean(b))/Math.sqrt((d3.variance(a)+d3.variance(b))/2);};
  const sep=separation("t");
  svg.append("rect").attr("x",pad).attr("y",pad).attr("width",620-pad).attr("height",H-2*pad).attr("rx",12).attr("fill","#fff").attr("stroke","#ddd");
  const clipId=`supervised-clip-${mode}`;
  svg.append("defs").append("clipPath").attr("id",clipId).append("rect").attr("x",pad+1).attr("y",pad+1).attr("width",618-pad).attr("height",H-2*pad-2).attr("rx",11);
  svg.selectAll("circle.raw").data(projected).join("circle").attr("class","raw").attr("clip-path",`url(#${clipId})`).attr("cx",d=>x(d.x)).attr("cy",d=>y(d.y)).attr("r",4.5).attr("fill",d=>colors[d.g]).attr("opacity",.78).attr("stroke","#fff").attr("stroke-width",.7);
  const boundaryAngle=angle+Math.PI/2,oldBoundaryAngle=oldAngle+Math.PI/2;
  const axis=svg.append("line").attr("stroke",brColors.ink).attr("stroke-width",3.5).attr("stroke-dasharray","8,5");
  const axisAttrs=(a,L)=>({x1:x(mx-L*Math.cos(a)),y1:y(my-L*Math.sin(a)),x2:x(mx+L*Math.cos(a)),y2:y(my+L*Math.sin(a))});
  const a0=axisAttrs(oldBoundaryAngle,oldMode===0?4.05:2.6),a1=axisAttrs(boundaryAngle,mode===0?4.05:2.6);
  Object.entries(a0).forEach(([k,v])=>axis.attr(k,v));
  axis.transition().duration(duration).ease(d3.easeCubicInOut).attr("x1",a1.x1).attr("y1",a1.y1).attr("x2",a1.x2).attr("y2",a1.y2);
  svg.append("text").attr("x",pad+14).attr("y",pad+22).attr("font-size",12).attr("font-weight",800).attr("fill",brColors.dark).text(mode===0?"PCA · horizontal line":"PLS · vertical line");
  svg.append("text").attr("x",mode===0?x(mx+2.15):x(mx)+12).attr("y",mode===0?y(my)-10:y(my-1.7)).attr("font-size",12).attr("font-weight",800).attr("fill",brColors.ink).text("selected line").attr("opacity",0).transition().delay(duration*.7).duration(220).attr("opacity",1);
  const bx=680,cy=180,oldTx=d3.scaleLinear().domain(d3.extent(projected,d=>d.ot)).nice().range([bx+12,978]),tx=d3.scaleLinear().domain(d3.extent(projected,d=>d.t)).nice().range([bx+12,978]);
  svg.append("text").attr("x",bx).attr("y",58).attr("font-size",18).attr("font-weight",900).attr("fill",brColors.dark).text(mode===0?"PCA scores overlap":"PLS scores separate");
  svg.append("text").attr("x",bx).attr("y",82).attr("font-size",13).attr("fill",brColors.ink).text("Both classes on the same score axis");
  [{label:"orange",x:bx,color:colors[0]},{label:"teal",x:bx+92,color:colors[1]}].forEach(d=>{
    svg.append("circle").attr("cx",d.x+6).attr("cy",108).attr("r",5).attr("fill",d.color);
    svg.append("text").attr("x",d.x+17).attr("y",113).attr("font-size",12).attr("font-weight",800).attr("fill",d.color).text(d.label);
  });
  svg.append("line").attr("x1",tx.range()[0]).attr("x2",tx.range()[1]).attr("y1",cy).attr("y2",cy).attr("stroke","#cfcfcf").attr("stroke-width",2);
  byGroup.forEach((vals,g)=>{
    const sorted=vals.map(d=>d.t).sort(d3.ascending),q1=d3.quantile(sorted,.25),q3=d3.quantile(sorted,.75),mean=d3.mean(sorted);
    svg.append("rect").attr("x",tx(q1)).attr("y",cy-18).attr("width",Math.max(2,tx(q3)-tx(q1))).attr("height",36).attr("rx",9).attr("fill",colors[g]).attr("opacity",.16);
    svg.selectAll(`circle.score-${g}`).data(vals).join("circle").attr("class",`score-${g}`).attr("cx",d=>oldTx(d.ot)).attr("cy",d=>cy+((d.i*17)%29-14)*1.55).attr("r",3).attr("fill",colors[g]).attr("opacity",.58).attr("stroke","#fff").attr("stroke-width",.35).transition().duration(duration).ease(d3.easeCubicInOut).attr("cx",d=>tx(d.t));
    svg.append("line").attr("x1",tx(mean)).attr("x2",tx(mean)).attr("y1",cy-34).attr("y2",cy+34).attr("stroke",colors[g]).attr("stroke-width",3.5);
  });
  svg.append("text").attr("x",bx).attr("y",272).attr("font-size",13).attr("font-weight",700).attr("fill","#666").text("standardized separation");
  svg.append("text").attr("x",978).attr("y",320).attr("text-anchor","end").attr("font-size",48).attr("font-weight",900).attr("fill",mode===0?brColors.orange:brColors.green).text(oldSep.toFixed(2)).transition().duration(duration).tween("text",function(){const n=d3.interpolateNumber(oldSep,sep);return t=>this.textContent=n(t).toFixed(2);});
  globalThis.__brDirectionMode=mode;globalThis.__brDirectionSep=sep;
  return svg.node();
}
```

::: {.notes}
- Click PCA, then PLS: the selected line rotates from horizontal to vertical while the score display and separation statistic update.
- Explain PLSkern for continuous outcomes and PLS-DA for class labels.
- Timing: 2 minutes.
- [Sources] PLS kernel method and API: https://senresearch.github.io/BigRiverEssence.jl/dev/plskern_tutorial/
:::

## Sparsity changes a direction into a feature list {#sparsity}

<p class="br-small">Move the threshold: dense loadings become a short set of retained variables.</p>

```{ojs}
sparseWeights = {
  const rng=brRng(74), p=42;
  return d3.range(p).map(i=>({name:`gene ${i+1}`,w:(i<9?(1.05-.06*i)*(i%2?-1:1):.22*(rng()-.5))}));
}

viewof sparseKeep = {
  const wrap=html`<div style="display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;font-size:17px"></div>`;
  const r=html`<input type="range" min="2" max="25" step="1" value="8" style="width:280px;accent-color:#E78824">`;
  const v=html`<b style="color:#C14C23">8</b>`;
  const set=x=>{r.value=x;v.textContent=x;wrap.value=+x;wrap.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true}));};r.oninput=()=>set(r.value);wrap.value=8;wrap.append(html`<b>Variables retained:</b>`,r,v);return wrap;
}
```

```{ojs}
sparseFig = {
  const dat=sparseWeights,W=1020,H=330,pad={l:42,r:18,t:34,b:46};
  const order=d3.range(dat.length).sort((a,b)=>Math.abs(dat[b].w)-Math.abs(dat[a].w)),keep=new Set(order.slice(0,sparseKeep));
  const svg=d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox",`0 0 ${W} ${H}`).style("width","100%").style("font-family","inherit");
  const x=d3.scaleBand(d3.range(dat.length),[pad.l,W-pad.r]).padding(.25),m=d3.max(dat,d=>Math.abs(d.w))*1.1,y=d3.scaleLinear().domain([-m,m]).range([H-pad.b,pad.t]);
  svg.append("line").attr("x1",pad.l).attr("x2",W-pad.r).attr("y1",y(0)).attr("y2",y(0)).attr("stroke","#aaa");
  svg.selectAll("rect").data(dat).join("rect").attr("x",(_,i)=>x(i)).attr("width",x.bandwidth()).attr("y",d=>Math.min(y(0),y(d.w))).attr("height",d=>Math.abs(y(d.w)-y(0))+.5).attr("fill",(_,i)=>keep.has(i)?brColors.orange:"#d9d9d9");
  svg.append("text").attr("x",W-pad.r).attr("y",23).attr("text-anchor","end").attr("font-size",17).attr("font-weight",900).attr("fill",brColors.dark).text(`${sparseKeep} of ${dat.length} variables active`);
  svg.append("text").attr("x",W/2).attr("y",H-10).attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",13).attr("fill","#666").text("orange = retained · grey = loading set to zero");
  return svg.node();
}
```

<div class="br-notice">Implemented through PMD, sparse PCA, sparse CCA, and sparse PLS-DA.</div>

::: {.notes}
- Stress interpretability: the result names a small set of variables, not only a score.
- `keepX` in SPLSDA controls retained variables per component.
- Timing: 2 minutes.
- [Sources] Sparse methods and API: https://github.com/senresearch/BigRiverEssence.jl ; https://senresearch.github.io/BigRiverEssence.jl/dev/splsda_tutorial/
:::

## JIVE separates agreement from individuality {#integration}

<p class="br-small">The same samples are measured by several assays. Increase the shared signal and watch the joint portion grow.</p>

```{ojs}
viewof jointShare = {
  const wrap=html`<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-size:17px"></div>`;
  const r=html`<input type="range" min="0.05" max="0.85" step="0.01" value="0.48" style="width:300px;accent-color:#E78824">`,v=html`<b style="color:#C14C23">48%</b>`;
  const set=x=>{r.value=x;v.textContent=`${Math.round(100*x)}%`;wrap.value=+x;wrap.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true}));};r.oninput=()=>set(r.value);wrap.value=.48;wrap.append(html`<b>Shared signal:</b>`,r,v);return wrap;
}
```

```{ojs}
jiveFig = {
  const names=["Transcriptome","Proteome","Metabolome"],W=960,H=330,pad={l:90,r:30,t:40,b:50},svg=d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox",`0 0 ${W} ${H}`).style("width","100%").style("font-family","inherit");
  const x=d3.scaleBand(names,[pad.l,W-pad.r]).padding(.42),y=d3.scaleLinear().domain([0,1]).range([H-pad.b,pad.t]);
  const remainder=1-jointShare,indivFraction=[.56,.44,.50];
  const indiv=indivFraction.map(f=>remainder*f),resid=indiv.map(v=>remainder-v);
  const segs=[{name:"Residual",vals:resid,color:"#d9d9d9"},{name:"Individual",vals:indiv,color:brColors.green},{name:"Joint",vals:names.map(()=>jointShare),color:brColors.orange}];
  let base=names.map(()=>0);
  segs.forEach(s=>{svg.selectAll(`rect.${s.name}`).data(names).join("rect").attr("x",d=>x(d)).attr("width",x.bandwidth()).attr("y",(_,i)=>y(base[i]+s.vals[i])).attr("height",(_,i)=>y(base[i])-y(base[i]+s.vals[i])).attr("fill",s.color);base=base.map((b,i)=>b+s.vals[i]);});
  svg.append("g").attr("transform",`translate(0,${H-pad.b})`).call(d3.axisBottom(x).tickSizeOuter(0)).selectAll("text").attr("font-size",13).attr("font-weight",700);
  svg.append("g").attr("transform",`translate(${pad.l},0)`).call(d3.axisLeft(y).ticks(5).tickFormat(d3.format(".0%"))).selectAll("text").attr("font-size",12);
  const lg=svg.append("g").attr("transform",`translate(${W-330},18)`);segs.slice().reverse().forEach((s,i)=>{lg.append("rect").attr("x",i*105).attr("width",14).attr("height",14).attr("fill",s.color);lg.append("text").attr("x",i*105+20).attr("y",12).attr("font-size",12).attr("fill",brColors.ink).text(s.name);});
  return svg.node();
}
```

::: {.notes}
- JIVE expects variables by observations and common columns across blocks.
- Mention block scaling: center and normalize so a large assay cannot dominate.
- Timing: 2 minutes.
- [Sources] JIVE API/tutorial: https://senresearch.github.io/BigRiverEssence.jl/dev/jive_tutorial/ ; original method cited in package README.
:::

## The handoff is deliberately simple {#bridge}

```{ojs}
bridgePulse = Generators.observe(notify => {
  let i=0; notify(i);
  const id=setInterval(()=>notify(++i),900);
  return ()=>clearInterval(id);
})
```

```{ojs}
bridgeFig = {
  const items=[
    {x:90,label:"fit",sub:"BigRiverEssence",color:brColors.green},
    {x:280,label:"scores",sub:"observations",color:brColors.orange},
    {x:470,label:"loadings",sub:"variables",color:brColors.orange},
    {x:660,label:"variance / VIP",sub:"importance",color:brColors.orange},
    {x:900,label:"plot",sub:"BigRiverPlots",color:brColors.green}
  ], active=bridgePulse%items.length,W=1000,H=270;
  const svg=d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox",`0 0 ${W} ${H}`).style("width","100%").style("font-family","inherit");
  items.slice(0,-1).forEach((d,i)=>svg.append("line").attr("x1",d.x+70).attr("x2",items[i+1].x-70).attr("y1",130).attr("y2",130).attr("stroke",i<active?brColors.orange:"#ccc").attr("stroke-width",5));
  items.forEach((d,i)=>{svg.append("circle").attr("cx",d.x).attr("cy",130).attr("r",i===active?62:52).attr("fill",i===active?d.color:"#fff").attr("stroke",d.color).attr("stroke-width",4);svg.append("text").attr("x",d.x).attr("y",126).attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",i===active?16:14).attr("font-weight",900).attr("fill",i===active?"#fff":brColors.dark).text(d.label);svg.append("text").attr("x",d.x).attr("y",148).attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",10.5).attr("fill",i===active?"#fff":"#666").text(d.sub);});
  return svg.node();
}
```

## Plot recipes keep analysis and styling separate {#plots-intro}

::: columns
::: column

<div class="br-code">

```julia
using BigRiverEssence
using BigRiverPlots
using Plots

m = pca(X; k=4, standardize=true)
S = pca_transform(m, X)

plot_scree(m.propOFvar)
plot_scores(S; group=phenotype)
plot_biplot(S, m.loadings)
```

</div>

:::
::: column

### Why RecipesBase?

- lightweight recipe definitions
- standard `Plots.jl` attributes still work
- plotting functions accept familiar arrays
- consistent validation and defaults
- both new-plot and mutating `!` forms

<div class="uthsc-green-box" style="font-size:.78em;">
The package supplies statistical grammar; the backend supplies rendering.
</div>

:::
:::

::: {.notes}
- BigRiverPlots itself depends on RecipesBase, not Plots; users load Plots to render.
- Timing: 1.5 minutes.
- [Sources] Package architecture and examples: https://github.com/senresearch/BigRiverPlots.jl
:::

## Explore one fit through several views {#plot-explorer}

```{ojs}
plotChoices = ["Scree","Scores","Loadings","VIP","Sparsity","Prediction","JIVE variance"]

viewof plotPick = {
  const wrap=html`<div class="br-selector"></div>`;
  const bs=plotChoices.map((x,i)=>{const b=html`<button>${x}</button>`;b.onclick=()=>{wrap.value=i;draw();wrap.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true}));};wrap.append(b);return b;});
  const draw=()=>bs.forEach((b,i)=>b.classList.toggle("on",i===wrap.value));wrap.value=0;draw();return wrap;
}
```

```{ojs}
plotExplorer = {
  const pick=plotPick,W=1000,H=370,svg=d3.create("svg").attr("viewBox",`0 0 ${W} ${H}`).style("width","100%").style("font-family","inherit"),O=brColors.orange,G=brColors.green,D=brColors.dark;
  const title=t=>svg.append("text").attr("x",W/2).attr("y",28).attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",17).attr("font-weight",800).attr("fill",D).text(t);
  const axes=(x,y,{left,bottom,xLabel,yLabel,xFormat=null,yFormat=null,xTicks=null,yTicks=5})=>{
    const xa=d3.axisBottom(x).tickSizeOuter(0),ya=d3.axisLeft(y).ticks(yTicks).tickSizeOuter(0);
    if(xFormat)xa.tickFormat(xFormat);if(yFormat)ya.tickFormat(yFormat);if(xTicks)xa.tickValues(xTicks);
    const gx=svg.append("g").attr("transform",`translate(0,${bottom})`).call(xa),gy=svg.append("g").attr("transform",`translate(${left},0)`).call(ya);
    [gx,gy].forEach(g=>{g.selectAll("text").attr("font-size",11).attr("fill","#555");g.selectAll("path,line").attr("stroke","#777");});
    svg.append("text").attr("x",(left+x.range()[1])/2).attr("y",366).attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",13).attr("font-weight",700).attr("fill",D).text(xLabel);
    svg.append("text").attr("transform",`translate(18,${(55+bottom)/2}) rotate(-90)`).attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",13).attr("font-weight",700).attr("fill",D).text(yLabel);
  };
  if(pick===0){
    title("Variance explained by component"); const vals=[.48,.24,.12,.07,.04,.025,.015,.01],x=d3.scaleBand(d3.range(vals.length),[80,940]).padding(.28),y=d3.scaleLinear().domain([0,.52]).range([320,55]);
    svg.selectAll("rect").data(vals).join("rect").attr("x",(_,i)=>x(i)).attr("y",d=>y(d)).attr("width",x.bandwidth()).attr("height",d=>320-y(d)).attr("fill",O);svg.append("path").attr("d",d3.line()(vals.map((d,i)=>[x(i)+x.bandwidth()/2,y(d)]))).attr("fill","none").attr("stroke",G).attr("stroke-width",3);axes(x,y,{left:80,bottom:320,xLabel:"component",yLabel:"variance explained",xFormat:i=>`C${i+1}`,yFormat:d3.format(".0%")});
  } else if(pick===1){
    title("Observations in component space"); const rng=brRng(9),groups=d3.range(90).map(i=>({x:(i%3-1)*2.2+(rng()-.5)*1.8,y:(i%3-1)*.8+(rng()-.5)*2.1,g:i%3})),x=d3.scaleLinear().domain([-4,4]).range([80,940]),y=d3.scaleLinear().domain([-3,3]).range([325,55]),cs=[O,G,"#5b78b2"];
    svg.selectAll("circle").data(groups).join("circle").attr("cx",d=>x(d.x)).attr("cy",d=>y(d.y)).attr("r",6).attr("fill",d=>cs[d.g]).attr("opacity",.75);axes(x,y,{left:80,bottom:325,xLabel:"component 1 score",yLabel:"component 2 score"});
  } else if(pick===2||pick===3){
    title(pick===2?"Variable contributions to component 1":"Ranked variable importance"); const rng=brRng(21),vals=d3.range(24).map(i=>pick===2?1.1*Math.sin(i*.65)+.25*(rng()-.5):1.75*Math.exp(-i/8)+.12*(rng()-.5));if(pick===3)vals.sort((a,b)=>b-a);const x=d3.scaleBand(d3.range(vals.length),[70,950]).padding(.2),y=d3.scaleLinear().domain([pick===2?-1.5:0,1.9]).range([325,55]),zero=y(0);
    svg.selectAll("rect").data(vals).join("rect").attr("x",(_,i)=>x(i)).attr("width",x.bandwidth()).attr("y",d=>Math.min(zero,y(d))).attr("height",d=>Math.abs(y(d)-zero)).attr("fill",d=>pick===3&&d<1?"#ccc":O);if(pick===3)svg.append("line").attr("x1",70).attr("x2",950).attr("y1",y(1)).attr("y2",y(1)).attr("stroke",G).attr("stroke-dasharray","6 5").attr("stroke-width",2);axes(x,y,{left:70,bottom:325,xLabel:"variable",yLabel:pick===2?"loading on component 1":"VIP score",xFormat:i=>`V${i+1}`,xTicks:[0,3,7,11,15,19,23]});
  } else if(pick===4){
    title("Variables retained on each sparse component"); const vals=[9,12,7,10,6],x=d3.scaleBand(d3.range(5),[140,900]).padding(.35),y=d3.scaleLinear().domain([0,20]).range([320,60]);svg.selectAll("rect").data(vals).join("rect").attr("x",(_,i)=>x(i)).attr("y",d=>y(d)).attr("width",x.bandwidth()).attr("height",d=>320-y(d)).attr("fill",G);svg.selectAll("text.count").data(vals).join("text").attr("class","count").attr("x",(_,i)=>x(i)+x.bandwidth()/2).attr("y",d=>y(d)-9).attr("text-anchor","middle").attr("font-size",17).attr("font-weight",900).attr("fill",D).text(d=>d);axes(x,y,{left:140,bottom:320,xLabel:"sparse component",yLabel:"variables retained",xFormat:i=>`C${i+1}`,yTicks:4});
  } else if(pick===5){
    title("Held-out predictions against observations"); const rng=brRng(33),pts=d3.range(65).map(i=>{const x=70+30*rng();return{x,y:x+2.3*(rng()-.5)};}),x=d3.scaleLinear().domain([68,102]).range([90,900]),y=d3.scaleLinear().domain([68,102]).range([325,55]);svg.append("line").attr("x1",x(68)).attr("x2",x(102)).attr("y1",y(68)).attr("y2",y(102)).attr("stroke",D).attr("stroke-dasharray","7 5");svg.selectAll("circle").data(pts).join("circle").attr("cx",d=>x(d.x)).attr("cy",d=>y(d.y)).attr("r",5).attr("fill",O).attr("opacity",.72);axes(x,y,{left:90,bottom:325,xLabel:"observed outcome",yLabel:"predicted outcome",xTicks:null,yTicks:5});
  } else {
    title("Joint, individual, and residual variation"); const names=["RNA","Protein","Metabolite"],x=d3.scaleBand(names,[140,900]).padding(.4),y=d3.scaleLinear().domain([0,1]).range([325,55]),joint=[.46,.38,.52],ind=[.31,.42,.24],res=joint.map((d,i)=>1-d-ind[i]);let base=[0,0,0];[[res,"#ddd","residual"],[ind,G,"individual"],[joint,O,"joint"]].forEach(([vals,c,cls])=>{svg.selectAll(`rect.${cls}`).data(names).join("rect").attr("class",cls).attr("x",d=>x(d)).attr("width",x.bandwidth()).attr("y",(_,i)=>y(base[i]+vals[i])).attr("height",(_,i)=>y(base[i])-y(base[i]+vals[i])).attr("fill",c);base=base.map((b,i)=>b+vals[i]);});axes(x,y,{left:140,bottom:325,xLabel:"data block",yLabel:"variance fraction",yFormat:d3.format(".0%")});
  }
  return svg.node();
}
```

::: {.notes}
- Click through the views quickly; dwell on scores, VIP, prediction, and JIVE variance.
- These are browser-generated analogues of the package plot types, not screenshots.

## One fit can tell several stories, one view at a time {#automatic}

<p class="br-small">Use Next to move through the analytical questions in a deliberate sequence.</p>

```{ojs}
viewof autoView = {
  const wrap=html`<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center"></div>`,label=html`<b style="color:#C14C23;min-width:260px"></b>`,btn=html`<button style="padding:6px 16px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#007E5A;color:#fff;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer">Next →</button>`;
  let i=0; const names=["scree: how many?","scores: which samples?","loadings: which variables?","VIP: which matter most?","prediction: does it generalize?"];
  const push=()=>{label.textContent=names[i];wrap.value=i;wrap.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true}));};
  btn.onclick=()=>{i=(i+1)%names.length;push();};
  wrap.value=0;wrap.append(btn,label);push();return wrap;
}
```

```{ojs}
autoSummary = {
  const steps=[
    ["Choose complexity","Keep the components that carry meaningful signal.","48% · 24% · 12%"],
    ["Inspect observations","See clusters, gradients, and outlying samples.","scores = X × loadings"],
    ["Interpret components","Trace each axis back to the original variables.","genes · metabolites · features"],
    ["Prioritize variables","Rank contributions to a supervised model.","VIP > 1"],
    ["Check generalization","Compare held-out predictions with observations.","distance from y = x"]
  ],d=steps[autoView],card=html`<div style="margin:26px auto 0;max-width:900px;border-top:6px solid #E78824;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:28px 36px;box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.12);text-align:center;min-height:230px"></div>`;
  card.append(html`<div style="font:900 32px inherit;color:#C14C23;margin-bottom:18px">${d[0]}</div>`);card.append(html`<div style="font:500 20px/1.45 inherit;color:#2a2a2a;margin-bottom:22px">${d[1]}</div>`);card.append(html`<div style="font:800 18px inherit;color:#4D701F">${d[2]}</div>`);return card;
}
```

::: {.notes}
- Click Next through the five questions and stop wherever discussion is useful.
- Use it to emphasize that plotting is analysis, not decoration at the end.
- Timing: 1.5 minutes.
- [Sources] Plot purposes: https://senresearch.github.io/BigRiverPlots.jl/dev/
:::

<div class="br-code">

```julia
using BigRiverEssence
using BigRiverPlots
using Plots

# 1. extract structure
m = splsda(X, class, 3, [20, 15, 10])

# 2. inspect observations
plot_scores(m.variates_X;
    group = class)

# 3. inspect variables
plot_loadings(m.loadings_X;
    comp = 1,
    varnames = gene_names)

# 4. report sparsity
plot_sparsity(m.loadings_X)
```

</div>

:::
::: column

### The design principle

1. Fit with a method named for the statistical task.
2. Read ordinary matrix outputs.
3. Send those outputs to a plot named for the question.
4. Customize through familiar `Plots.jl` attributes.

<div class="uthsc-green-box" style="font-size:.78em;margin-top:18px;">
The workflow is explicit enough to teach, inspect, test, and extend.
</div>

:::
:::

::: {.notes}
- Explain that `keepX` is specified per component.
- If the audience asks about fields, refer to the SPLSDA docs and exported model struct.
- Timing: 2 minutes.
- [Sources] SPLSDA API: https://senresearch.github.io/BigRiverEssence.jl/dev/splsda_tutorial/ ; plotting APIs: https://senresearch.github.io/BigRiverPlots.jl/dev/
:::

## Install the pieces you need {#install}

::: columns
::: column

### Registered packages

```julia
using Pkg
Pkg.add("BigRiverEssence")
Pkg.add("BigRiverPlots")
```

### Load a plotting backend

```julia
using BigRiverEssence
using BigRiverPlots
using Plots
```

:::
::: column

### Development versions

```julia
Pkg.add(url =
  "https://github.com/senresearch/BigRiverEssence.jl",
  rev = "main")

Pkg.add(url =
  "https://github.com/senresearch/BigRiverPlots.jl",
  rev = "main")
```

## What I want the ecosystem to make easy {#future}

<div class="br-pipeline" style="grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr auto 1fr;">
<div class="br-stage"><h3>Fit</h3><p>Efficient decompositions for high-dimensional biological data.</p></div>
<div class="br-arrow">→</div>
<div class="br-stage green"><h3>Understand</h3><p>Stable outputs that expose the statistical structure directly.</p></div>
<div class="br-arrow">→</div>
<div class="br-stage"><h3>Communicate</h3><p>Reusable plots with consistent behavior and familiar customization.</p></div>
</div>

<div class="uthsc-orange-box br-center">
A small, composable foundation for downstream biostatistics packages—not a monolithic framework.
</div>

## Three ideas to leave with {#takeaways}

<div class="br-method-grid" style="margin-top:34px;">
<div class="br-stage"><h3>1 · Match method to question</h3><p>Variance, prediction, sparsity, correlation, and integration need different decompositions.</p></div>
<div class="br-stage green"><h3>2 · Keep outputs transparent</h3><p>Scores, loadings, variance, VIP, predictions, and joint/individual structure form the interface.</p></div>
<div class="br-stage"><h3>3 · Treat plots as analysis</h3><p>Each view asks a specific question of the fitted structure.</p></div>
</div>

::: {.notes}
- Resolve the opening promise.
- Timing: 1 minute.
:::
